subject: Insurance
title: Pay-Per-Mile Insurance
description: A quick, practical guide to Pay-Per-Mile Insurance.

hook.text: Metromile charges drivers per mile driven.

buildup.text: Traditional insurance charges a flat annual rate regardless of how much you drive.

discovery.text: Pay-per-mile uses an OBD-II plug-in to count miles. The base rate covers the car; the per-mile rate covers driving risk.

twist.text: Remote workers and retirees save thousands annually.

climax.text: Usage-based insurance aligns cost with actual risk exposure. Less driving means less risk means less premium.

punchline.text: Drive less, pay less. Per-mile insurance matches cost to actual use.

quiz.question: How does pay-per-mile insurance work?
options: Charges based on miles driven using an OBD-II device
